policy: Classify actual authorship, not the forum domain. Prefer original Kabam publications. Community sources remain explicit where no primary publication verifies the exact claim. General activity announcements do not independently prove exact inventory-item names, star levels or objective permanence.
wordpressEvidence: Article ID, publication timestamp and SHA-256 of content.rendered were recovered from Kabam public WordPress API. Links use public canonical article URLs. Stream summaries are classified separately from announcements.
